properties.name: Verbalized Machine Learning
properties.description: Natural-language parameters condition LLM execution and are revised from predictions and labels.
properties.transfer_limit: No general semantic correctness, convergence or HSWM efficacy theorem.

properties.name: TextGrad
properties.description: Textual feedback proposes changes to computation-graph variables.
properties.transfer_limit: Textual gradient is not an ordinary derivative or identified causal credit.

properties.name: GEPA
properties.description: Trajectory reflection proposes and evaluates prompt changes and combines complementary candidates.
properties.transfer_limit: No general optimality claim; current review is abstract and version metadata, HTML full text unavailable.

properties.name: DreamCoder
properties.description: Program synthesis and library abstraction learning broaden reusable programs.
properties.transfer_limit: Given DSL and task family; no open-world grounding or arbitrary variable discovery guarantee.

properties.name: Exact Is Easier: Credit Assignment for Cooperative LLM Agents
properties.description: Complete-history restoration, frozen continuation, independent alternative actions and leave-one-out estimates of per-decision advantage.
properties.transfer_limit: Requires the complete restorable state and sampling conditions; not external-world causal truth or positive policy improvement.

properties.name: Memory-R2
properties.description: Compare local memory-operation rerollouts from the same intermediate anchor memory.
properties.transfer_limit: Local/global LoGo-GRPO is not a theorem of unbiased full-horizon causal credit; text-only evidence.

properties.name: Doubly Robust Off-policy Value Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning
properties.description: Sequential value estimator with unbiasedness and recursive variance analysis.
properties.transfer_limit: Known policy ratios, support and evaluation-data separation required; long-horizon variance remains.

properties.name: Time-uniform confidence sequences
properties.description: Uniform coverage over time; bounded process and randomized treatment-effect constructions.
properties.transfer_limit: Does not automatically cover mutated candidates, multiple selection, label contamination or future population shift.

properties.name: Compositional abstraction error and a category of causal models
properties.description: Finite interventional model transformations with compositional Jensen-Shannon-distance error bounds.
properties.transfer_limit: No useful compression learner, LLM realization or Learn preservation without additional construction.

properties.name: Hyperon official deep-dive whitepaper
properties.description: Persistent metagraph and neural integration paths with implementation/prototype/research distinctions.
properties.transfer_limit: Mandatory comparator; whitepaper design is not an executable complete-AGI baseline or HSWM efficacy evidence.

properties.name: A synthetic approach to Markov kernels
properties.description: Compositional probabilistic language for joint kernels and conditional independence.
properties.transfer_limit: Does not provide actual LLM independence, calibration or learning improvement.

properties.name: Local stochastic semantics and read sufficiency
properties.description: Normalized finite joint kernels, approximate read collision bound and a useful bounded-read extension rule.

properties.name: Identified contribution of a revision
properties.description: Separate frozen-history local action credit from randomized external-outcome revision effects.

properties.name: Fresh-outcome acceptance with power and cost
properties.description: Derive data-based coverage, contamination correction, multiple-comparison control and finite acceptance under sufficient margin.

properties.name: Grounded relation and variable proposal
properties.description: Use LLM semantic priors and library growth with observable referents, revision lineage and the same evaluation contract.

properties.name: Joint Step and Learn composition
properties.description: Construct useful macro maps preserving coupled outputs, intervention responses, learning and consequential uncertainty within an error budget.

properties.name: Runtime transfer and mandatory comparisons
properties.description: Connect the same construction to actual TS/Effect and a fixed LLM with independent outcomes, world/self and continuity tests, matched-budget controls and Hyperon.
